nodes.name: Write Reminder Email
nodes.notes: Wording is unchanged from v3. Stage 4 wording is the final notice; the PMS uses it for the last stage only.

nodes.name: Get reminder plan (PMS)
nodes.notes: Asks the PMS app which overdue invoices should get a reminder today. Returns nothing when automatic reminders are switched off, at weekends (if set) or when nothing is due. Header Auth credential: Name = X-Hinkley-Sync-Key, Value = the PMS_SYNC_KEY secret (same as the COHO actions sync).

nodes.name: PMS: run action
nodes.notes: Called by the PMS app for "Send reminder now", "Re-send Xero invoice" and "Add note in Xero". Header Auth credential: the same one as the Xero gateway webhook (X-Hinkley-Gateway-Key). The production URL of this node goes in the PMS secret N8N_REMINDER_WEBHOOK_URL.

nodes.name: Xero: email invoice
nodes.notes: Re-sends the invoice to the customer using Xero's own email template. Live mode only (the PMS refuses it in test mode).

nodes.name: Xero: add history note
nodes.notes: Adds a note to the invoice's History & notes in Xero. Live mode only.

nodes.name: Xero: note the reminder
nodes.notes: Live reminders only, when "Note reminders in Xero" is ticked in the PMS settings.

nodes.name: Report result to PMS
nodes.notes: Logs each result against the invoice in the PMS (reminder log and follow-up history). Same Header Auth credential as "Get reminder plan (PMS)".

parameters.content:
## Payment reminders (PMS-controlled)
The app decides who gets a reminder (Invoices page: on/off switch, test or live, stages, pauses). This workflow writes and sends each reminder, re-sends invoices and adds Xero notes when the app asks, and reports every result back to the app (Finance checks > Reminders sent).

The overdue digest, cost-increase alerts and their data tables moved into the app: see the **Xero daily checks** workflow.

nodeGroups.name: Pull 12-month bill history
nodeGroups.description: Paid and unpaid supplier bills from the last 12 months across all five organisations, used as the spending baseline

nodeGroups.name: Alert on unusual cost rises
nodeGroups.description: Compares last month and new recurring bills with normal spend, emails you each new rise once and records it

nodeGroups.name: Payment reminders (controlled by the PMS app)
nodeGroups.description: The PMS app decides who gets a reminder (on/off, test or live, one stage at a time, skips paused, disputed, promised, recently chased and Xero-reminded invoices). This branch writes and sends the email and reports back.

nodeGroups.name: Xero actions on request
nodeGroups.description: Re-send an invoice from Xero, or add a note to its History, when a person asks from the PMS Invoices page (live mode only).
